approved_scope.title: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
approved_scope.description: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: CI workflow ordering only; no canonical spec owns .github/workflows
acceptance_criteria: CI's Archive job runs first via CorvidLabs/spec-sync archive-gate-only at the #832 merge commit; product, native-gates, the existing SpecSync Archive job and ci-fixtures all need it, so a pull request with an open change under .specsync/changes/ runs nothing else.
